stories.title: Falcons upset Packers in Michael Penix Jr.'s return from ACL injury
stories.summary: Bijan Robinson and Drake London couldn't be stopped, as Atlanta ended Green Bay's streak of 13 straight home-opening wins.

stories.title: Penix shows 'resiliency' in return, revives Falcons' attack in Lambeau rout
stories.summary: In his first game since tearing his ACL last November, Michael Penix Jr. sparked the Falcons by passing for 256 yards with a touchdown in a 35-14 rout of the Packers at Lambeau Field.

stories.title: LaFleur on Packers' offensive woes: 'I don't know what we're doing well'
stories.summary: The Packers are off to their worst start in coach Matt LaFleur's eight seasons after they were booed off Lambeau Field on Thursday night.

stories.title: White Sox clinch AL playoff berth after 324 losses over previous 3 seasons
stories.summary: The White Sox became the first team to follow consecutive 100-loss seasons by reaching the playoffs, clinching at least an AL Wild Card berth with win No. 82 this year.

stories.title: 49ers' Juszczyk baffled by NFL fine for imitating 'chugging a beer'
stories.summary: The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 on Thursday for "engaging in offensive demonstrations."
